replication.target_description: Comparison of female and male respondents on the number of women named. Target correspondence unresolved unless explicitly stated in notes.

reported_success.location: p.33, Individual differences in the tendency to mention women and related variables
reported_success.quote:
In line with the original study (Stahlberg et al., 2001), one significant variable was
participant sex. That is, independently of the condition participants were in, women named more
women than men did.
